name: Sumibiyaki Arashi

menus.name: Sumibiyaki Arashi omakase
menus.note: Yakitori-led charcoal-grill omakase with seasonal fish and vegetable dishes, at a 14-seat counter. Two sittings, 5:30pm and 8pm. Optional add-ons are offered, while they last.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable only. A whole month's tables open on the 1st of the month before at 9am Vancouver time. Tables are for two or four guests; solo diners can ask by email once the month is released. The restaurant does not answer the phone, so questions go to sumibiyaki.arashi@gmail.com. Bookings are not transferable, and resold ones are cancelled.
cancellation: Cancel or change by email at least 72 hours ahead. Later cancellations, changes and no-shows are charged $195 per person plus processing fees. The meal starts on time: guests more than 15 minutes late miss courses, and after 30 minutes the booking counts as a no-show.
waitlist: Use OpenTable's Notify feature to hear when a matching table frees up; email and social media waitlist requests are not taken.
groups: Only parties of two or four; several bookings joined to make a bigger party are declined. Whole-restaurant buyouts by email.
dressCode: Business casual or smart casual. No sportswear, sweatpants, beachwear, pyjamas or flip-flops.
duration: About two and a half hours.
byob: Corkage only by arrangement before the visit, one bottle per party, no 1.8-litre bottles, outside glassware or spirits.
